purpose: Fresh terse player-language Gate 3 tranche G benchmark authored after r17 deployment and not used to construct r17.
blindnessPolicy: This tranche was authored after r17 was merged and deployed and was not used to construct r17.
Do not edit or retroactively regrade this tranche after its first paid live run.
Do not exactly reuse prior Gate 2 or Gate 3 A/B/C/D/E/F player-language questions.
Semantic criteria are limited to the answer actually requested.

cases.question: setup token placement triggers enter effects?

semanticCriteria.statement: Setup placement is not entering the Territory, so enter triggers do not fire.
A generic additional Action does not permit two Actions in one phase unless an effect says so.
A negated Gambit normally still goes to its owner's Graveyard during the Aftermath.

cases.question: can i look at their facedown bound card?
expectedSourcePatterns: face-down bound card may be inspected only by its owner

semanticCriteria.statement: Only the owner may inspect a face-down bound card.

cases.question: battle ended. can i onward now?
expectedSourcePatterns: Onward cannot be used after a battle

semanticCriteria.statement: Onward cannot be used after a battle.

cases.question: six treaties during their turn. instant win?
expectedSourcePatterns: At the start of the Diplomat's turn

semanticCriteria.statement: Peace Treaty is checked at the start of the Diplomat's turn after Capture and before Draw, not immediately during the opponent's turn.

cases.question: treasury card uses asset slot?
expectedSourcePatterns: Treasury is not the Asset Bank

semanticCriteria.statement: Treasury cards do not use Asset capacity.
An aborted Mission goes to the Discard Pile; aborting is not failure.
Counterintelligence does not stop rules-mandated reveals.

cases.question: lose before echoes completes. bound cards where?

semanticCriteria.statement: Both bound cards go to the Graveyard and the Rite resets.

cases.question: purge in opening lets me act again in opening?
expectedSourcePatterns: never permits two Actions in one phase

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Purge never permits two Actions in the same phase.

cases.question: no martyrs blocks their bad loss trigger too?

semanticCriteria.statement: No. No Martyrs blocks beneficial loss/retreat effects controlled by the loser, not harmful consequences.
Entrench requires defending and is unavailable while attacking.
Mission Control cannot start a Special Operation.

cases.question: arcane gambit hits graveyard after battle. materia prima?
expectedSourcePatterns: A Gambit does not trigger Materia Prima

semanticCriteria.statement: A Gambit entering the Graveyard from battle during the Aftermath does not by itself trigger Materia Prima.

cases.question: pursuit starts battle. can terms still end it?
expectedSourcePatterns: Accepted Terms may still end the resulting battle sequence

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes. Accepted Terms can end the Pursuit-created battle during Onset.

cases.question: margin loan banked means no normal draw?
expectedSourcePatterns: may not draw at the start of your turn

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes. While Margin Loan remains banked, its controller may not draw at the start of the turn.

cases.question: war crimes win then order?
expectedSourcePatterns: cannot move, capture a Territory, or use an Order

semanticCriteria.statement: No. War Crimes prohibits using an Order as a result of that victory.
